caption: The drawing depicts a single object positioned centrally within a rectangular frame. The object appears to be a roughly cubic form with rounded edges and corners, rendered in shades of brown, ochre, and dark gray. The main surface is textured with closely spaced, curved, parallel lines running diagonally across its sides. At the top face of the object, there is a small, circular, concentric pattern, resembling a button or depression, outlined in darker and lighter tones to indicate depth. The background is plain and uncolored, offering contrast to the object, and the outer area of the drawing includes a thin rectangular border. The drawing is signed "HUMAGALLI" in the lower left corner.
title: Inkwell
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
